snippet.title: Blood West: Scavengers - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
The $5 Endless Roguelite DLC for Blood West arrives in a month! Thanks for playing the beta, y'all!

Yee haw: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4051310/Blood_West_Scavengers/

Your feedback was actually super invaluable. We should do these betas more often. Or not. It's Whatever.
